description.value: The Kluachon Store & Cafe is a combined convenience store, fuel station, and full-service café operated by the Iskut Development Corporation on the Stewart-Cassiar Highway (Highway 37) in the remote community of Iskut, BC. The café serves everything from eggs and omelettes at breakfast to burgers, sandwiches, poutine, and 16-inch pizzas at lunch. For touring cyclists on this isolated northern corridor—where OSM notes there is no mobile reception—it is a rare multi-service resupply stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at iskutdevcorp.com/kluachon-store/ confirms an active, operational business in Iskut on the Stewart-Cassiar Highway (Hwy 37), run by the Iskut Development Corporation; it advertises gas, diesel, car EV chargers, a full café menu (breakfast, lunch, pizza), and everyday store essentials. The OSM name 'Kluachon Centre Store' differs from the website's consistent branding as 'Kluachon Store & Cafe', flagged in concerns. Bike parking, washrooms, and most other amenities are not mentioned on the website or in OSM tags and are treated as null; EV chargers are confirmed for cars but e-bike compatibility is not specifically stated, so E-bike charging remains null.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the business as 'Kluachon Centre Store' but the website consistently brands it as 'Kluachon Store & Cafe'.
OSM had no phone number; phone field populated from website contact page (Store: 250-234-3241; Cafe: 250-234-3212). Store number used as primary.
